source: Generated locally; no private data, securities or empirical results

cases.title: A high Sharpe can come from selecting noise
cases.interpretation: Full-sample selection is a deliberate negative control. The two selections are evaluated on the identical last 252 rows. The data-generating process has zero expected return; a realized gain is not alpha.
cases.limitations: DSR is an approximate evidence statistic, not a posterior probability of profitability. CSCV is not chronological forward validation. No costs, execution or real-market structure are modeled in this IID teaching fixture.

cases.title: A reporting period is not an availability date
cases.calendar: Synthetic weekdays, NOT an exchange holiday calendar
cases.interpretation: The existing PIT aligner exposes a value only on the next session strictly after max(notice_date, update_date). A later restatement must not alter earlier features. Missing notice_date raises ValueError.
cases.limitations: The example audits availability, not return prediction. Real studies also need exchange calendars, timestamps and historical vendor vintages; an aligner cannot reconstruct revisions that a vendor discarded.

cases.title: Mixing price bases can change a cross-sectional rank
cases.factor: vwap / close - 1 (toy expression, not a validated factor)
cases.basis_guard: rejects raw cash fallback against adjusted OHLC
cases.interpretation: Preserve the supplied adjusted OHLC4 proxy with its provenance. Raw amount/raw volume is not an adjusted price. Symbol-specific adjustment histories need not cancel in ranks; no dates or names were removed from the comparison.
cases.limitations: OHLC4 is not transaction VWAP, and basis consistency is not predictive power. This explicit-metadata fixture cannot certify arbitrary vendor data. The adapter is demonstration-only and does not change the discovery input loader.
